note: Derivation (08-classes.md §1 rule; record in ADDENDA-2026-11 → 08 §3i): every hobby Chrome prospect auto of 2018 Bowman (Chrome Prospect Autographs, 43; Cardboard Connection 2018 Bowman set page), 2018 Bowman Chrome (Bowman Chrome Prospect Autograph, 80 = 54 BCPA- + 26 CPA-; Cardsmiths full checklist) and 2018 Bowman Draft (Chrome Draft Pick Autographs, 62; Cardboard Connection), read Nov 1 2026, matched by accent-folded player name against every Chrome prospect auto list of 2015-2017 Bowman (BCAP 50 / CPA 35 / CPA 46), Bowman Chrome (BCAP 75 / mixed BCAP+CPA 57 / CPA 63) and Bowman Draft (BCA 60 / CDA 56 / CDA 76) (Cardboard Connection set pages, read Nov 1 2026) and against earlier 2018 releases. 3 false (McKay, Gore, Lewis — 2017 Bowman Draft CDAs), 1 held (Maitan, 2017 Bowman CPA-KM ATL vs 2018 Chrome BCPA-KM LAA; name-collision rule), 181 true. Cross-checks with BOW19: Bohm, Singer, Mize, Madrigal (2018 Draft CDAs) and Capel (2018 Chrome BCPA-CC) are true here, matching BOW19's five 2018 false rows; Guerrero Jr.'s 2016 Chrome CPA-VG is on the 2016 list. Paper PA- autos, rookie (CRA-/BCRA-), insert, dual, AFL, Sterling and Scouts' Top 100 autos are not priors or class rows (08 §1, G61). Open before universeComplete: (1) 2018 Bowman Mega Box / Chrome Mega Box prospect auto sets not enumerated; (2) 2018 Draft list one source (Cardboard Connection) — a second source for the 62; (3) priors read back to 2015 only — a 2014-or-earlier Chrome auto would be missed; (4) Maitan; (5) all three consoles patterned; (6) one source per prior list.
